import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Link {
        int origin;
        int destination;
        long capacity;
        long charge;
        long utilization;
        
        Link(int o, int d, long cap, long chrge) {
            origin = o;
            destination = d;
            capacity = cap;
            charge = chrge;
            utilization = 0;
        }
    }
    
    static final int NODE_LIMIT = 5007;
    static final long LARGE_NUM = 1000000000L;
    static final long MODULO = 1000000007L;
    
    static List<Link> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static long[] dist_array = new long[NODE_LIMIT];
    static long[] phi_array = new long[NODE_LIMIT];
    static List<Integer>[] neighbor_list = new List[NODE_LIMIT];
    static int[] parent_edge = new int[NODE_LIMIT];
    
    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < NODE_LIMIT; i++) {
            neighbor_list[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }
    
    static void connect(int u, int v, long cap, long cost) {
        neighbor_list[u].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Link(u, v, cap, cost));
        neighbor_list[v].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(new Link(v, u, 0, -cost));
    }
    
    static void setup_potentials(int source, int steps) {
        Arrays.fill(phi_array, LARGE_NUM);
        phi_array[source] = 0;
        for (int pass = 0; pass < steps; ++pass) {
            for (int k = 0; k < edges.size(); ++k) {
                Link e = edges.get(k);
                if (e.capacity == e.utilization) continue;
                if (phi_array[e.origin] == LARGE_NUM) continue;
                if (phi_array[e.origin] + e.charge < phi_array[e.destination]) {
                    phi_array[e.destination] = phi_array[e.origin] + e.charge;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static void update_distances(int source) {
        Arrays.fill(dist_array, LARGE_NUM);
        dist_array[source] = 0;
        PriorityQueue<Pair> q = new PriorityQueue<>();
        q.offer(new Pair(0, source));
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Pair cur = q.poll();
            long cur_dist = cur.first;
            int u = cur.second;
            
            if (cur_dist != dist_array[u]) continue;
            
            for (int eid : neighbor_list[u]) {
                Link e = edges.get(eid);
                if (e.capacity == e.utilization) continue;
                int v = e.destination;
                long cost = e.charge + phi_array[u] - phi_array[v];
                if (dist_array[u] + cost < dist_array[v]) {
                    dist_array[v] = dist_array[u] + cost;
                    parent_edge[v] = eid;
                    q.offer(new Pair(dist_array[v], v));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static class Pair implements Comparable<Pair> {
        long first;
        int second;
        
        Pair(long f, int s) {
            first = f;
            second = s;
        }
        
        @Override
        public int compareTo(Pair other) {
            if (first != other.first) {
                return Long.compare(first, other.first);
            }
            return Integer.compare(second, other.second);
        }
    }
    
    static class Result {
        long total_charge;
        long total_flow;
        
        Result(long tc, long tf) {
            total_charge = tc;
            total_flow = tf;
        }
    }
    
    static Result min_cost_max_flow(int src, int dst) {
        setup_potentials(src, 50);
        update_distances(src);
        long total_flow = 0, total_charge = 0;
        
        while (dist_array[dst] != LARGE_NUM) {
            long delta = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            long path_cost = 0;
            for (int x = dst; x != src; ) {
                int e_id = parent_edge[x];
                delta = Math.min(delta, edges.get(e_id).capacity - edges.get(e_id).utilization);
                path_cost += edges.get(e_id).charge;
                x = edges.get(e_id).origin;
            }
            
            total_flow += delta;
            total_charge += delta * path_cost;
            
            for (int x = dst; x != src; ) {
                int e_id = parent_edge[x];
                edges.get(e_id).utilization += delta;
                edges.get(e_id ^ 1).utilization -= delta;
                x = edges.get(e_id).origin;
            }
            
            update_distances(src);
            for (int i = 0; i < NODE_LIMIT; ++i) {
                phi_array[i] = dist_array[i];
            }
        }
        
        return new Result(total_charge, total_flow);
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c_val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d_val = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        int[] people = new int[n];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            people[--a]++;
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            connect(5000, i, people[i], 0);
        }
        
        for (int step = 0; step < m; ++step) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            
            for (int t = 0; t < 99; ++t) {
                long time_cost = d_val;
                for (int r = 0; r < 50; ++r) {
                    connect(u + t * 50, v + (t + 1) * 50, 1, time_cost);
                    connect(v + t * 50, u + (t + 1) * 50, 1, time_cost);
                    time_cost += 2 * d_val;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int t = 0; t <= 99; ++t) {
            connect(t * 50, 5001, Long.MAX_VALUE, c_val * t);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int t = 0; t < 99; ++t) {
                connect(i + t * 50, i + (t + 1) * 50, Long.MAX_VALUE, 0);
            }
        }
        
        Result ans = min_cost_max_flow(5000, 5001);
        System.out.println(ans.total_charge);
    }
}
